title: Compact Commercial Fusion
tagline: 20-compact superconducting magnets and pulsed power shrink fusion cores 40x—repowering retired coal switchyards with 24/7 bottled starlight.
cynicBelief: Fusion is thirty years away and always will be—a multi-billion-dollar government science project trapped in cathedral-sized tokamaks that burn taxpayer cash faster than deuterium.
breakthroughCounter: REBCO 20T high-field superconducting tape (scaling fusion power density via B⁴) shrank plasma chambers >40x. By late 2026, CFS has raised ~$4B with SPARC 85%+ assembled in Massachusetts for 2027 net energy and a 400 MWe Virginia ARC plant contracted to Google, while Helion's Orion in Washington holds the world's first commercial fusion power license for a 2028 Microsoft PPA.
socialNormShift: Regulating fusion like hospital particle accelerators (US NRC 10 CFR Part 30) and dropping compact cores into 2,400+ GW of retiring coal switchyards shifts electricity from anxious per-kilowatt scarcity metering to calm, flat-rate monthly abundance.

humanStory.snippet: Beside kayak docks that replaced six stories of coal ash, Mateo routes 400 MWe from a timber-clad ARC fusion hall through his grandfather's 1974 coal switchyard—while winter district warmth grows Meyer lemons down the street and families pay a flat $14/month grid membership.

quote.text: Every energy source in human history is a form of hunting and gathering... If you know how to build a fusion plant, you can build one wherever it's needed. That turns energy into a technology, and technologies face far fewer limits on how fast they spread or who gets access.
quote.author: Dr. Bob Mumgaard

title: 35.5% Perovskite-Silicon Tandems & Living Solar Skins
tagline: Stacking sub-micron perovskite crystals onto silicon shatters the 29% ceiling—turning roofs, berry farms, and facades into <$8/MWh electron fountains.
cynicBelief: Solar panels already hit their physics limit near 23%, pave over prime farmland with black glass, degrade in damp heat, and still cost American families $30,000 because of utility red tape.
breakthroughCounter: LONGi certified a 35.5% crystalline silicon-perovskite tandem cell in 2026 while Oxford PV, Caelux, and Heliene ship 26%–28%+ commercial modules with IEC 61215 damp-heat armor. Combined with drought-shielding agrivoltaic canopies and 5-minute automated permitting, midday solar drops below $8/MWh.
socialNormShift: Replacing four-month municipal paperwork with Australia/SolarAPP+ 5-minute instant digital permits, supermarket balcony plug-in solar, and 'Free Afternoon Power' tariffs democratizes clean wealth for farmers, homeowners, and apartment renters alike.

tagline: Horizontal diamond drilling and 400 °C+ superhot rock turn oilfield roughnecks into builders of 24/7 carbon-free power beneath any city.

tagline: Reusable super-heavy launch and solid-state phased arrays beam unfiltered 24/7 orbital sunshine through winter clouds to any spot on Earth.
cynicBelief: Launching gigawatts of solar panels on rockets is absurdly expensive sci-fi—and beaming energy from orbit sounds like a giant orbital death ray that will fry birds in midair.

socialNormShift: Just as satellite constellations brought instant internet to remote villages without trenching transoceanic fiber, software-steered orbital energy democratizes firm winter power and 2-second disaster relief without 10-year transmission clear-cuts.

title: Walk-Away-Safe Gen IV Fission & Microreactors
tagline: Melt-proof 1,800 °C TRISO ceramic pebbles, atmospheric salt loops, and truck-delivered microreactors replace coal boilers and Arctic diesel.
cynicBelief: Nuclear power means $35-billion bespoke concrete domes that run ten years behind schedule, require high-pressure water pipes that risk meltdowns if backup pumps fail, and leave behind ten-thousand-year waste.
breakthroughCounter: TRISO silicon-carbide ceramic pebbles stay intact past 1,800 °C while passive Doppler physics halts reactions without pumps or valves. Kairos Power's atmospheric-pressure molten-salt reactors are rising in Oak Ridge for Google's 500 MW PPA, TerraPower's Natrium is repowering Kemmerer WY coal, and Radiant/Oklo microreactors fit on trucks.
socialNormShift: Following France's 15-year Messmer Plan and the bipartisan US ADVANCE Act (88–2), standardized factory assembly and fence-line passive safety turn nuclear from terrifying one-off megaprojects into welcomed coal-town and off-grid industrial appliances.
